ItemID: 1; Title: Echo Auto (1st gen) - Hands-free Alexa in your car with your phone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My car purchases focus on GPS mounts and connections; I have no current need for Alexa in the car.
ItemID: 2; Title: Seagate Expansion 16TB External Hard Drive HDD - USB 3.0, with Rescue Data Recovery Services (STKP16000402); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Backup storage interests me given my camera and memory-card use, but I would check whether I need this much capacity before choosing it.
ItemID: 3; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not currently need a dedicated smart display for video calls or Alexa.
ItemID: 4; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A voice-controlled speaker does not address the camera, storage, or connection needs I am shopping for.
ItemID: 5; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My existing tablet covers my screen needs, and I have no specific use for another small display.
ItemID: 6; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Streaming on my television sounds useful, but I would check compatibility and available services before choosing it.
ItemID: 7; Title: Amazon Smart Plug, for home automation, Works with Alexa - A Certified for Humans Device; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My power-strip purchases were practical connection purchases; I do not currently need voice-controlled outlets.
ItemID: 8; Title: Fire HD 10 Tablet (10.1" 1080p full HD display, 64 GB) – Black (2019 Release); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a Fire 7 and have no clear reason to replace it right now.
ItemID: 9; Title: Logitech MK270 Wireless Keyboard And Mouse Combo For Windows, 2.4 GHz Wireless, Compact Mouse, 8 Multimedia And Shortcut Keys, For PC, Laptop - Black; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current keyboard or mouse replacement need, and Windows compatibility alone does not make this useful to me.
ItemID: 10; Title: Amazon Basics HDMI Cable, 18Gbps High-Speed, 4K@60Hz, 2160p, Ethernet Ready, 10 Foot, Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this to connect my DVD player and television; the extra length could make placement easier.
